title: Information System for Reporting Scientific Publications and Scientometric Indicators with Automated Bibliographic Verification: Source Code and Data

creators.name: Madzharov, Anastas

description:
Open-source information system for reporting the scientific publications and scientometric indicators of a research unit, built as a bilingual (Bulgarian / English) static website (Astro) with GitHub Actions automation. Deployed at the Unmanned Robotic Systems Laboratory (URSlab), Institute of Robotics, Bulgarian Academy of Sciences: https://urs.ir.bas.bg.

Main functions: (1) entry of publications through a web form with APA 7 validation and automated verification of DOI, ISSN and ISBN in public registers (doi.org, Crossref, DataCite, NACID National Reference List, ISSN Portal, Open Library); (2) yearly publication pages, per-user summary reports, filters and CSV export, share of institute authors; (3) automated discovery of citations (OpenAlex, OpenCitations COCI, Semantic Scholar), pre-verification against the reference lists of the citing works and one-tick confirmation; (4) indexing check of the citing venues against the Scopus and Web of Science source lists and a proposed NACID indicator (D-12 / D-13 / D-14), peer review established through the NACID National Reference List; (5) calculation of the points under the Minimum National Requirements for academic positions (Bulgaria, Area 5 Technical Sciences), exclusion of works presented in earlier procedures according to the NACID register, and a strategy for the next position, sent as a PDF only to the user and the head of the unit.

The archive contains the source code (Apache-2.0), the user guides and site content (CC BY 4.0) and a snapshot of the public data entered through the system. The Scopus and Web of Science source lists are not included.
notes: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23659986. Version 1.0.0 of the information system corresponds to release v1.8.0 of the urslab-site repository (see CHANGELOG.md).
